mechanism: Oxacillin may reduce spironolactone efficacy through hepatic metabolism induction and increased renal clearance, while concurrent use increases hyperkalemia risk due to spironolactone's potassium-sparing effects in the context of renal function changes.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and renal function regularly; adjust spironolactone dose if needed based on clinical response and electrolyte status during oxacillin therapy.
